about.title: A nonprofit built on the Triple Helix model
about.description: CSI A.C. is the startup and innovation cluster of Puebla. It brings government, academia and industry together so building a tech startup in the state becomes the rule. Nonprofit, with open governance. An innovation hub is in the process of launching.
